book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.1: Subject drinks fermented grain, then challenges a cactus to a duel. The cactus wins. Subject apologises to it.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.10: Specimen 4471 will not stop saying "yeehaw". Procedure abandoned. Specimen returned with tag. Specimen still saying it.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.11: The large horned food-animals do not like us. We cannot think why. We have only taken a few of their organs.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.12: In the drinking house one specimen strikes a box of wires and hammers. When weapons come out, it stops. When they are put away, it starts again. The most orderly thing on the planet.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.13: We pressed a perfect circle into a wheat field to test their mathematics. They blamed "kids". Tested again. They blamed kids again. Their young must be remarkable.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.14: The specimen in the dark coat asked for long life in return for his silence. He is very bad at silence. He tells the barmaid everything.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.15: Specimens crave a bitter black liquid called coffee. One drank eleven cups and spotted us from a mile off. Recommend this planet be kept away from coffee.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.16: Attempted to blend in at a drinking house. Wore a hat. Ordered "one beverage". The barmaid called us "sugar". Unsure if discovered.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.2: The specimens greet each other by touching their hats. Removing a specimen's hat causes great distress. Do not remove the hats again.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.3: Specimens trade small metal discs for beans. Value of the discs: unknown. Value of the beans: also unknown.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.4: Observed a specimen load its weapon. This took forty heartbeats. The weapon then failed to fire because of rain. They hold this whole continent somehow.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.5: Took specimen 2231 for study and returned it after one night. It told the others. Nobody believed it. Very convenient.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.6: The specimens keep a small four-legged animal, the "cat", in the house of law. The cat does not appear to serve them. They do not seem to mind.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.7: Each seventh day the specimens sit in rows and sing at the sky. We went to look. They were not singing at us. Disappointing.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.8: A specimen pointed at our craft and shouted "airship". There is no air in our ship. Observer corrected it. It fainted.
book.hollowfrontier.field_notes.9: Specimens put their dead in the ground and carve a joke above them. Purpose unclear. Observer 7 laughed. Observer 7 has been reprimanded.

book.hollowfrontier.pilots_log.1: day four hundred and nine. hull breached over the dry country. drive failing. the burning stone is spent.
book.hollowfrontier.pilots_log.2: the people here are kind. they gave me water. they cannot know what we do to their cattle, or what we are making of their lost men.
book.hollowfrontier.pilots_log.3: if this is found: the way in is at the pole. the light inside is not a sun. the lit ones were there first. ask them.
book.hollowfrontier.pilots_log.4: i will not go back. let the others look for me.
book.hollowfrontier.prospector_notes.1: Day 3. Found the black pool the Symmes men wrote of. Bones in it bigger than a locomotive. A tusk long as a wagon tongue, and ivory fetches a price back home.
book.hollowfrontier.prospector_notes.2: Day 5. The tar takes whatever it's given. Lost a boot to it, then the mule nearly. Hauled the tusk halfway out before the light went the color it goes here at no particular time.
book.hollowfrontier.prospector_notes.3: Day 6. Big birds at the edge again, watching. They don't come close. Something in the trees does. It doesn't walk like a bird and it doesn't walk like a man.
book.hollowfrontier.prospector_notes.4: Day 7. Lights over the pool last night, slow and quiet. Anyone finds this: the tusk is yours. I'm going to look.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.1:
Symmes Polar Expedition, 1889.

We left the last of the pack ice on the fourth of June and found the sea running warm. The Captain says the old Colonel was right after all.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.2: The rim of the world curves away beneath us here. The compasses spin like tops. Nine days going down the great hole, the sun behind us shrinking to a star.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.3: Then a second sun, low and green-gold, that never sets. Ferns as tall as a church steeple. Beasts we have no names for. We have made camp by good water.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.4: Tomkins swears the pale stones up on the moors were cut by hands, and carved with letters older than Babel. He copied some down. None of us can read them.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.5: Lights in the sky again, though here there is no night to see them by. Something small and silver hung over the camp an hour, turning to look at each of us in turn.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.6: Tomkins went after the lights. We found his boots, and a ring burned into the grass. The men will not sleep. We start back for the hole at first light, if it lets us.
book.hollowfrontier.symmes_journal.7:
If you find this: the way home is the way you came, up through the ice. Keep the cold ahead of you.

Do not follow the lights.

  E. Hartwell
bossbar.hollowfrontier.raid.getaway: %s is getting away with the loot!
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.greet.1: Good day. Your money's safer with us than in your boots.
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.talk.1: Sneak a word to me and I'll open your box. A gold coin the first time, free after.
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.talk.2: Coins in a box earn a little every day. Come back and collect it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.talk.3: Keep your coin in the vault, not under the mattress. Mattresses catch fire.
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.talk.4: We'll make good on the boxes where we can. The vault is another story.
chatter.hollowfrontier.banker.talk.6: I'll take your deposit. I won't ask where it came from. Today.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.brawl.1: Not in my saloon! Take it outside!
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.exposed.1: And he never paid his tab!
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.1: Come on in out of the dust, darlin'.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.3: Late one, sugar? Bar's still open.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.4: Come in, come in, you're drippin' on my floor.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.5: Shut that door, darlin', there's a dust devil out there and I just swept.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.6: Where's your hat, sugar? Don't tell me. The wind's wearin' it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.7: Get down behind the bar and keep your head low!
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.greet.8: Back again? You saw it again, didn't you. Nobody else did. They never do.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.1: Not now, honey, they're shootin' up the street!
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.10: The drifters who come in now order coffee and say thank you. Strangest thing.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.11: A fella came in with a crate of saucer metal. Says the grey ones ran off and left it. Drinks are on him.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.12: A ship in the sky, all lit up? Sugar, that was the moonshine. It does that. Have a coffee.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.13: Odd fella. Tips well, though. Tips in rocks, but they glow, so I keep 'em.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.14: Orders a beer and just holds it. Hour after hour. Holds it real nice.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.2: Since the robbery folks drink more and tip less. Ain't that always the way.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.3: I'll pour for you, but the sheriff drinks here too. Drink fast.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.4: %s? Drank here Saturdays, till his face went up on the board.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.5: Well, ain't you a picture. Full cowboy rig, and boots to match.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.6: Honey, nobody wears a crown in a saloon. Not twice.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.7: Two men in black coats sat in the corner all night. Drank water. Asked about you.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.8: Somebody tipped me a glowing rock. I keep it by the till. Best lamp I ever had.
chatter.hollowfrontier.barmaid.talk.9: Every drunk in town's seen a saucer this week. Some of 'em even sober.
chatter.hollowfrontier.belle.talk.1: I don't believe a word of what's on that board, darlin'. Not one word.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.1: Iron shoes keep a horse sound on any trail. The starsteel kind, I hear, keep it from falling at all.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.2: Dynamite's for mining. I don't want to hear it was for anything else.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.3: Good iron's honest. Can't say the same for most men.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.4: Bring me a broken gun and I'll tell you what you did wrong.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.5: Damp gets in the coals. Everything comes out brittle on a wet day.
chatter.hollowfrontier.blacksmith.talk.6: Somebody brought me a red metal last month. Wouldn't so much as soften in my forge.
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.hurt.1: That all you got? I've been shot by better!
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.hurt.2: First blood to you. Last blood's mine.
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.spot.1: Read my poster? Then you know what's coming.
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.spot.2: There's a price on my head. Come and claim it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.spot.4: That's my face on that paper. Hope you said your goodbyes.
chatter.hollowfrontier.boss.taunt.1: Go on, load up. I'd hate to beat you unarmed.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.1: Hey! Hey, you're no Gray. Get me out of here.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.2: Keep your voice down. They hear everything. Then get me out.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.3: Is it day up there? I can't tell any more.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.4: The button's on your side of the bars, friend. I've been looking at it for a month.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.5: They took the fella in the next cell to the table. He came back wrong.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.greet.6: They stopped coming for the table. Just stopped. Something's got 'em spooked.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.1: There was a light over the barn. Then it was morning, and I was here. My wife'll think I ran off.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.2: I lost one night out on the trail. Just the one. Turned out to be most of a year.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.3: Two men in black coats came round the week before. Asked my neighbours if I slept sound.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.4: A man in a black coat paid my bar tab. I should've known. Nobody pays a bar tab.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.5: They put me on a cold table. Cold as a creek in January. Then the humming started.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.6: They don't talk. They look at you and you know what they mean. Mostly it's 'hold still'.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.7: Six weeks in that cell and not one cup of coffee. Write that down. That's the real crime.
chatter.hollowfrontier.captive.rescued.8: They left us down here when the sky went quiet. Forgot us, I reckon. I'm glad somebody didn't.
chatter.hollowfrontier.clementine.talk.1: Ooh, I hate thunder! Stay a while, would you?
chatter.hollowfrontier.deputy.greet.1: Howdy! I mean, halt! I mean... howdy.
chatter.hollowfrontier.deputy.talk.1: Sheriff lets me carry the shotgun. Says I can't miss with it. I've missed with it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.disguised_gray.gr: Howdy, fellow human. I, too, enjoy... beans.
Greetings, cow-person. I am also a cow-person.
Good evening. I will now drink this beverage. Later.
chatter.hollowfrontier.disguised_gray.ta: One beverage of fermented grain, please. For drinking. With my mouth.
I am from the town of... Elsewhere. It is a normal town. We have horses there.
This is a fine hat. It is my hat. I have always had this hat.
Yee. And, if I may, haw.
That sign you carry. I do not know it. I do not know what a Lantern Man is. Good day.
chatter.hollowfrontier.doctor.greet.1: Say "ah". No? Suit yourself. Next time you're shot, you'll come see me.
chatter.hollowfrontier.doctor.talk.1: I can set a bone, pull a tooth or cut out a bullet. Not all at once, mind.
chatter.hollowfrontier.doctor.talk.2: That snake oil at the store is mostly whiskey. So's half my medicine.
chatter.hollowfrontier.doctor.talk.3: Took three slugs out of the last fella who was wanted. Don't make it four.
chatter.hollowfrontier.editor.greet.1: Got news? I'll print it. Got none? I'll print something.
chatter.hollowfrontier.editor.talk.1: The Gazette goes to press at dawn. Ink on my fingers, ink in my coffee.
chatter.hollowfrontier.editor.talk.2: Sightings, raids, bounties. If it's strange, it's front page.
chatter.hollowfrontier.editor.talk.3: A dust devil went through the press room. Half this week's paper is somewhere over the next county.
chatter.hollowfrontier.editor.talk.4: "Lights Over the Mesa". Sold out by noon. Everybody's seen 'em; nobody'll say so.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.greet.1: Mind the rails. The four-fifteen don't stop for nobody.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.talk.1: I'll take your coal and your crusher dust. The smelter down the line eats it by the ton.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.talk.2: Pressure valves are a devil to make. I've a spare, for a price.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.talk.3: Steam's the future, friend. Horses are for folks who like waiting.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.talk.4: Wet rails and a heavy load. That's how a man meets his maker.
chatter.hollowfrontier.engineer.talk.5: Saw a light keep pace with the night train. Forty miles an hour, and it never fell behind.
chatter.hollowfrontier.freed.greet.1: Do you know what town this is? I used to know.
chatter.hollowfrontier.freed.greet.2: I had a wife. I think I had a wife.
chatter.hollowfrontier.freed.greet.3: I don't know what you did. But thank you.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.1.1: Did you hear the Hendersons' girl is sweet on the new deputy?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.1.2: The one who shot his own hat? Lord help her.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.10.1: Don't look now. That one's wanted.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.11.1: That stranger's carrying a poster for %s.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.11.2: Good. That one stole my mule.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.13.1: Men in black coats were at the hotel asking questions.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.13.3: About that one there. Keep walking.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.14.1: You see the lights last night?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.14.2: I ain't saying I saw 'em. But I saw 'em.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.15.1: See that dust devil this morning?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.15.2: Took my hat, my hen and my good mood.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.16.3: Or a saucer. Either way, it ain't coming back.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.17.1: Another steer, cut up neat. No blood.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.19.1: Hear about the saucer that set down?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.19.2: Set down? I thought they only flew over.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.2.1: Prices at the store went up again.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.2.2: Everything goes up out here but the rain.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.20.1: They say whoever runs the grey ones off gets what they leave behind.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.20.3: Ask the fella buying rounds at the saloon.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.21.1: Heard somebody went down the hole at the pole and came back.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.21.2: Came back from where? There's nothing up there but ice.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.22.1: Martha says she was taken up in a light and lost a whole night.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.22.2: Martha says a lot of things.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.22.3: She's got a mark behind her ear, though.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.24.1: That stranger asked me where the humans drink.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.24.3: The saloon. Where else would humans drink?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.25.1: Ever notice the new fella's hat's three sizes too big?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.3.1: My boy wants to be an outlaw when he grows up.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.4.1: Not a cloud in a week.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.4.2: The well's getting low. Pray for rain.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.5.3: You'd complain if it rained gold.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.7.1: Lamp's still on at the saloon.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.7.2: Lamp's always on at the saloon. That's the point of a saloon.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.8.1: They say the gang took every coin in the vault.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.8.2: Not every coin. I keep mine in my boot.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.8.3: Then I know where they'll look next time.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gossip.9.1: Is it over? Are they gone?
chatter.hollowfrontier.gunsmith.greet.1: Mind the muzzle, friend. Every gun's loaded till it ain't.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gunsmith.talk.1: Bring me a fouled barrel and I'll make it sing. Bring me coin and it'll sing louder.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gunsmith.talk.2: Caps, cartridges, buckshot. Powder dry, prices fair, no credit.
chatter.hollowfrontier.gunsmith.talk.3: Raiders! Take a box of cartridges and get to a window!
chatter.hollowfrontier.jailbird.jeer.1: Hey, you're on the board too! Come on in, plenty of room.
chatter.hollowfrontier.jailbird.jeer.2: It's quiet in my head now. Best sleep I've had in years, in here.
chatter.hollowfrontier.josie.talk.1: My table hits soft seventeen and pays double. Sit down if you've got the nerve.
chatter.hollowfrontier.kindled.talk.1: The crown of the Sun's keeper. Wear it well. Many died for it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.kindled.talk.2: You carry our sign. Our guardians know you by it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.kindled.talk.3: The grey ones grow bold above. We feel their ships pass through the crust.
chatter.hollowfrontier.kindled.talk.4: The leash is broken. For the first time in an age, the grey ones are afraid.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.arrest.1: That's one less outlaw on my roads.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.brawl.1: Alright, break it up! ...After this round.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.greet.3: Evening. Keep to the lit streets.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.greet.4: I know your face. Don't give me a reason.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.greet.5: Off the street, unless you're here to shoot!
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.muster.2: Form up! Nobody touches that bank!
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.posse.1: There! That's the one on the warrant!
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.posse.2: By order of the territory, you're coming in. Dead or alive.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.spot.3: In the name of the law, drop that iron!
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.1: Pay your fine at the board and we'll call it square. Until then, I'm watching.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.10: Outlaws I can shoot. Lights in the sky I just write down.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.11: The outlaws we jail can't remember their own mothers. Something's wrong with 'em.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.12: Half the outlaws in my cells this month just gave up. Asked for a preacher.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.13: There was a saucer down near here last night. Nobody's hurt, and I mean to keep it that way. You go near it, you go armed.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.14: Can't arrest a saucer. Lord knows I'd like to.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.2: They got clean away with the payroll. I'll see that gang hang if it takes all year.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.3: The leader's poster is on the board. Bring him in and the whole town will thank you.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.4: %s, eh? Bring him in breathing if you can. Dead pays the same.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.5: Got a poster on you. Good. The board pays out on his badge, mind.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.6: No time to jaw! Grab a gun or get indoors!
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.7: You dress like a lawman. Ever think of wearing the star?
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.8: Men in black dusters came by with federal papers. I didn't like them, and they didn't like you.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lawman.talk.9: Federal men keep asking about the polar country. I tell 'em what I know. Nothing.
chatter.hollowfrontier.lupe.talk.1: My abuela said the lights in the sky are the dead, riding home. Have a drink, it's late.
chatter.hollowfrontier.man_in_black.talk: You've been north. Further north than there is. We'd know.
Ground squirrels. They're organised out here.
Venus, swamp gas, coyotes. It's all been explained. Please stop asking.
A dust devil. They turn whichever way they please.
A dust devil picked up a lantern and carried it off. Happens all the time.
Dust devil. A very sharp one.
That's not yours. Nothing down there is yours.
The Lantern Men gave you that, didn't they. They aren't your friends.
Those lights? The planet Venus. She's very bright this time of year.
Geese. A flock of geese, lit from below. By the moon.
The steer had a weak heart. Then it fell on a scalpel.
chatter.hollowfrontier.marshal.talk.1: I've a warrant from Washington and a horse that hasn't eaten. One of us is in a hurry.
chatter.hollowfrontier.marshal.talk.2: Washington wants reports on the lights. Washington can come and look for itself.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.greet.1: Ah. A fellow regular. Pull up a stool. I have pulled up mine.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.talk.1: The usual, barkeep. I will look at it for an hour, as is our custom.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.talk.2: I have studied your species for a long time. The coffee is still a mystery to me.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.talk.3: You have a Sarsaparilla? I will give you something shiny for it. Please do not ask what it does.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.talk.4: The cards. The piano. The fighting on Saturdays. I find I would rather be here than up there.
chatter.hollowfrontier.mr_gray.talk.5: Your face is on the board. The artist has not captured your eyes. I know something about eyes.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.hurt.2: Ain't gonna end like this. Ain't gonna...
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.reload.2: Hold on, hold on, I'm dry!
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.reload.3: Powder, ball, cap... hurry, dang it!
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.reload.5: Nobody move! ...I mean it, nobody move till I'm loaded!
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.reload.6: Hold your fire a spell, would you? Much obliged.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.reload.7: Wet powder! Who loads a gun in the rain? Me, that's who.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.run.2: That's it, boys, we're done here!
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.run.3: Scatter! Meet at the old mine!
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.spot.2: Well, well. Look who came to die.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.spot.3: You picked the wrong trail, friend.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.spot.5: That a poster in your pocket? Come to collect, have you?
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.spot.6: It's in my head. It says you're the one.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.spot.7: No more voices in my head. I'm doin' this 'cause I want to.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.1: Take your time, partner. I'll wait.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.2: Powder, then the ball. You're doin' it backwards.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.3: Want me to hold your hat while you load?
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.4: My grandma loads faster, and she's dead.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.5: No hurry. I'm only shootin' at you.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.6: Load all you like. Your caps are wet as mine.
chatter.hollowfrontier.outlaw.taunt.7: Fancy duster. Shame about the reloading.
Mail goes out with the stage, Mondays and Thursdays. Rain, shine or outlaws.
chatter.hollowfrontier.postmaster.talk.1: A letter back east takes three weeks. A telegram takes three minutes and costs a week's wages.
chatter.hollowfrontier.postmaster.talk.2: I don't read the postcards. Don't need to. Folks tell me what's in 'em anyway.
chatter.hollowfrontier.preacher.greet.1: Bless you, stranger. Wipe your boots.
chatter.hollowfrontier.preacher.talk.1: Service is Sunday at nine. The saloon closes, and so do the eyes of half my flock.
chatter.hollowfrontier.preacher.talk.2: I preach against drink, cards and dancing. The barmaid says I'm bad for business.
chatter.hollowfrontier.preacher.talk.3: There are lights in the heavens that aren't in my Book. I'm writing a new sermon.
Gold in them hills! Or there was, till a fella from back east took it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.1: Fifty years I've panned these creeks. Got me a bad back and a good story.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.2: Dynamite and snakeskins, that's my trade. Both bite if you're careless.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.3: Ever hear of Symmes? Holes at the poles, he said, and a world inside. I believe him.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.4: I count the stars, nights. Some nights there's one too many, and it moves.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.5: You've been down there, ain't you? Down the hole! I knew Symmes was right!
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.6: Fella back from the pole swears there's folk down there who glow like a lamp. Lantern Men, he calls 'em.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.7: Funny thing. Ever since the sky went quiet, I sleep like a babe.
chatter.hollowfrontier.prospector.talk.8: Saw the saucer's lights through the trees. I went for a look, and one of the grey fellas looked back.
chatter.hollowfrontier.ranger.talk.1: Thirty years I've ridden this country. Never seen it so strange.
chatter.hollowfrontier.ranger.talk.2: Storm like this, the outlaws hole up. So do I.
chatter.hollowfrontier.ruby.talk.1: The card table's in the corner. I deal fair. Mostly.
chatter.hollowfrontier.sheriff.greet.1: Didn't recognise you from the poster. That's the artist's fault, not yours.
chatter.hollowfrontier.sheriff.talk.1: Jail's got three cells and a cat. The cat's the toughest thing in there.
chatter.hollowfrontier.sheriff.talk.2: I've hung better men than the ones still riding.
chatter.hollowfrontier.sheriff.talk.3: Your poster's up. Artist never laid eyes on you, but folks say he caught something.
Come in, come in! Everything a body needs, and some things it don't.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.1: Gazette's a copper. All the news, and some of it's even true.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.2: Got discs fresh off the train. Nothing livens up a saloon like a good rag.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.3: Lasso, cartridges, a hat that fits? You're in the right store.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.4: Credit? Friend, I don't give credit to my own brother.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.5: Can't restock till the payroll comes. Take what's on the shelf.
chatter.hollowfrontier.shopkeeper.talk.6: Fella tried to sell me a crystal that glowed. I bought it. Don't tell my wife.
chatter.hollowfrontier.teacher.greet.1: Good day. Hat off indoors, if you please.
chatter.hollowfrontier.teacher.talk.1: Spelling bee on Friday. The prospector's boy has spelled "gold" with an E four weeks running.
chatter.hollowfrontier.teacher.talk.2: Reading, writing, arithmetic, and not shooting at the school bell. That last one needs saying more than you'd think.
chatter.hollowfrontier.teacher.talk.3: Marking slates by lamplight. Half of them have drawn the sheriff's cat.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.brawl.1: You take that back about my mule!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.brawl.2: Hold my beer! No, really, hold it, I paid for it!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.exposed: I knew nobody tips that well!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.1: They're shooting up the bank! Run!
Quiet since the robbery. Folks are counting their pennies.
Saw what? Nobody saw nothing. Go and sleep it off.
Don't stare, but the tall fella in the big hat ain't blinked since Tuesday.
New fella in town. Says he's from Elsewhere. Never heard of it.
Out after %s, are you? Good luck to you.
Now there's somebody who looks like they belong out here.
Lord above, is that a crown? Real gold?
Dust devil came right down the street today. Took the washing clean off the line.
Lost your hat? Dust devil, was it? It'll turn up in Kansas.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.2: Nobody out here goes bareheaded on purpose, friend. Go find your hat.
You've got a look about you. Like you've been somewhere nobody's been.
Feels lighter out here lately. Can't say why.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.3: Hot one today. Keep your hat on.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.4: Evening. Mind the dark past the last lamp.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.6: Hear that thunder? Horses'll be skittish all night.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.7: ...I didn't see you. I don't see anybody.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.8: That's the face off the board! Somebody fetch the sheriff!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.greet.9: Get inside! Get off the street!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.1: Sweep the boardwalk in the morning, and a dust devil puts it all back by noon.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.10: They took the payroll and half our nerve. Prices are up a coin.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.11: Not now! Can't you hear the shooting?
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.12: I'll sell to you. Once. Then you'd best ride on.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.13: Fella in a black coat was asking after you. Polite. Too polite.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.14: Those men in black are looking for you. Don't bring 'em in here!
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.15: %s? I'd know that face. Rode through last spring and never paid for his beans.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.16: That poster's worth more than my whole stock. Bring him in, would you?
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.17: Fine duster. Chaps too. You ride for an outfit, or for yourself?
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.18: That pendant you carry hums, doesn't it? I can hear it from here.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.19: Wear that crown into the saloon and you won't keep it long.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.2: There's hats sold at the store. You'll want a chin strap this time.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.20: They say there's a hole at the top of the world. Fella at the bar swears he fell down it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.21: You smell of ferns. Where'd you find ferns out here?
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.22: Folks are locking their doors at night. Not for outlaws. For the lights.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.23: My cousin lost a whole night. Went to bed, woke up in the corn. Ain't been right since.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.24: No lights in the sky for weeks. I almost miss 'em. Almost.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.25: Some of the drifters came back to themselves. One's mending my roof. Good worker.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.26: One of them saucers set down outside town. Sat there all night, bold as brass, with its little grey men walking round it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.27: There's a ring of burnt ground past the creek. Saucer sat in it all night. Gone by sunup.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.28: They don't take folks no more. Now they just land where they please, like they own the place.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.3: Prices are fair. That's more than you'll say for the next town.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.4: Coin only. Paper money's for kindling out here.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.5: Take your time. Nobody hurries on the frontier but the undertaker.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.6: Heading out? Buy more caps than you think you'll need.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.7: Burning the lamp late for you. Don't make a habit of it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.8: Rain's good for the wheat and bad for business.
chatter.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.talk.9: Everything's dearer since the gang hit the bank. Can't be helped.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.greet.1: Watch where you step. The herd's been through.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.1: I'll buy snakeskins. Rattlers keep clear of a man in snakeskin boots.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.2: Shoe your horse before a long ride. Don't skimp on it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.3: Cattle smell weather before we do. They've been bunched up all day.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.4: A dust devil went through the corral and every horse in it stood on its hind legs. Shod ones didn't. Shoe your horse.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.5: Herd won't graze the east pasture no more. Something burned a ring in it.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.6: Cattle are calm again. They always know before we do.
chatter.hollowfrontier.wrangler.talk.7: Something came down in the far pasture last night. The herd wouldn't go near it, and I didn't blame 'em.

enchantment.hollowfrontier.choke.desc: A narrower muzzle keeps the buckshot together.
enchantment.hollowfrontier.deadeye.desc: Shots to the head do even more damage.
enchantment.hollowfrontier.dry_powder.de: Rain can't make the gun misfire.
enchantment.hollowfrontier.frugal.desc: Loading sometimes costs no cartridge or cap.
enchantment.hollowfrontier.quick_load.de: Each chamber or barrel loads faster.
enchantment.hollowfrontier.rifling.desc: Grooves cut down the barrel: each shot hits harder.
A man who rode with the gangs until the night the sky went quiet has pinned on a deputy's star near (%2$s, %3$s). %1$s paid his first coin. The sheriff says he's the hardest worker in the office, and the only one who knows where the other gangs hole up.
gazette.hollowfrontier.aftermath.general: It has been weeks since anyone saw lights over the plains. Ranchers report their cattle whole, their wheat standing, and their nerves much improved.
Men who went missing years ago are turning up at their families' doors, thin and puzzled, with no memory of where they've been. Most are just glad to be home. Their wives have questions.
The gentlemen in black dusters who asked so many questions last season have not been seen since. Their hotel bill remains unpaid.
The county reports fewer gangs on the roads than in any year since the railroad came. Those still riding are said to be doing it the old-fashioned way, out of plain greed.
gazette.hollowfrontier.aftermath.homecom: Another of the drifters has put his gun away and settled near (%2$s, %3$s), thanks to %1$s. He has taken up prospecting. Neighbours report that he is polite, quiet, and very bad at it.
gazette.hollowfrontier.aftermath.ruin.bo: Travellers back from the Hollow Earth say the old crystal ruins near (%2$s, %3$s) are being built up again, tower by tower. The Lantern Men who live there are said to be pleased. Nobody can say who is paying for it.
gazette.hollowfrontier.aftermath.wayston: A standing stone in the crystal ruins near (%2$s, %3$s) has woken, and is said to carry a traveller from one ruin to the next, or up to the polar gateways, for one phlogiston shard. The railroad has been asked for comment, and is said to be worried.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.1: FOR SALE: one mule, stubborn. Also one mule, very stubborn. Ask at the livery.
FOR SALE: saucer part, still humming. No questions asked. Or answered.
FOR HIRE: a man with a telescope and no fear of the dark. Watches skies, a dollar a night.
FOR SALE: one strongbox. Never opened by its owner. Lightly opened by others.
FOR SALE: lead-lined nightcap. The sky's quiet now, and the owner wants his hair back.
LOST: one good hat, last seen heading east at a gallop. Reward.
FOR SALE: hats, with chin straps. Ask the reader who has just lost one.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.2: WANTED: piano player who keeps playing through a gunfight. Steady work.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.3: LOST: one left boot, near the creek. The right boot is offered as a reward.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.4: FOR SALE: Doc's Snake Oil, by the crate. Cures all ills. Doc has left town.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.5: WANTED: a deputy. Must own a hat. Must not shoot it.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.6: NOTICE: the sheriff's cat is not for sale, and has asked us to say so.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.7: FOR SALE: percussion caps. Will not fire in the rain. Neither will yours.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.8: FOR SALE: warm socks, one pair. The seller has been to the pole and is not going back.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.classified.9: WANTED: anyone who has seen a large bird with teeth. My friend is up a tree.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.1: Our report of the church social said that nobody was shot. One man was shot, slightly, by himself. We regret the error.
We reported a twister through the stockyard. It was a dust devil, and it took only the stockman's hat. He would like it back.
Gentlemen from out of town have asked us to say that last week's lights were a dust devil carrying a lantern. We have said it.
We reported that the sky has been quiet for a month. A goose flew over on Thursday. We regret the alarm.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.2: Beans are three coppers a can, not two. The Editor blames the railroad again.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.3: Mrs. Henderson's prize pie was peach, not "peacheous". The typesetter has been spoken to.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.4: The outlaw in last week's Wanted column has written to say that he is taller than that.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.5: We said the new deputy shot an outlaw's hat clean off. It was his own hat. He was wearing it.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.6: Last week's paper said the mayor was eaten by a mammoth. He was only sat on. He is resting comfortably, and so is the mammoth.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.7: We reported that a prospector fell down a hole at the top of the world. He has written to say that he jumped.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.8: Gentlemen from out of town have asked us to correct last week's correction. It was not the planet Venus after all. It was a different planet. They did not say which.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.correction.9: The Gazette printed nothing about lights in the sky last week. Readers who remember reading it are mistaken.
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.1:
Sir,
The new bandstand is a disgrace. A band played on it Sunday, and I could hear it.

— A Resident
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.10:
Sir,
I did not make the rings in my wheat, and I resent my neighbours' suggestion that I have taken up dancing.

— A Farmer
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.11:
Sir,
On Saturday last I was taken up into a light and shown many wonders. I should like to know who will pay for my fence.

— A Citizen
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.12:
Sir,
The lights have stopped. I have nothing left to write to you about.

P.S. The bandstand is still a disgrace.
— A Resident
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.2:
Sir,
My husband says he was at the church social on Tuesday. Your paper says it was Thursday. I should like a word with him, then with you.

— Mrs. E. Tolliver
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.3:
Sir,
The steam carriage in your paper was mine, and the horses started it.

— An Inventor
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.4:
Sir,
I have read the Gazette for nine years, and it has never once got the price of beans right. Keep it up.

— A Grocer
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.5:
Sir,
The Earth is not hollow. I have begun a hole behind my house to prove it, and will write again when I reach the bottom.

— A Skeptic
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.6:
Sir,
A stranger paid for flour with a crystal that glows. My wife reads by it now. Is it legal tender?

— A Shopkeeper
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.7:
Sir,
I would thank the owners of the airship to put their lights out after ten. Some of us work in the morning.

— A Rancher's Widow
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.8:
Sir,
To whoever took the insides out of my best steer: I want him back. Or the liver, at least.

— A Rancher
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.9:
Sir,
A dust devil took my laundry on Tuesday. If the gentleman two towns over is wearing my Sunday shirt, I should like it pressed.

— A Widow
gazette.hollowfrontier.back.letter.title: LETTERS TO THE EDITOR
gazette.hollowfrontier.gateway.body: No word from the Polar Survey since it reached a crater of blue ice near X %s, Z %s. Their last letter spoke of a ring of carved stones that hummed when struck, and asked for more coal.
gazette.hollowfrontier.gateway.title: EXPEDITION LOST IN THE SNOWS
gazette.hollowfrontier.mystery.correctio: The Gazette regrets its report of rings in the wheat. Gentlemen from out of town have kindly explained that it was a hailstorm, and some boys with a plank. The Editor has nothing further to add.
The Gazette regrets its report of a craft set down in the night. Gentlemen from out of town have kindly explained that it was a grass fire. The Editor has been asked not to go and look.

The Gazette regrets its report of a steer found strangely cut. Gentlemen from out of town have kindly explained that it was wolves. The Editor is glad to have it cleared up, and would rather not discuss it further.

The Gazette regrets its report of lights in the sky. Gentlemen from out of town have kindly explained that the witnesses saw a weather balloon, and the planet Venus. The Editor sees no reason to doubt them.
gazette.hollowfrontier.mystery.crop_circ: %s day(s) ago farmers near %s, %s woke to find rings pressed into a ripe field, every stalk laid flat and not one broken. Nobody heard a thing.
gazette.hollowfrontier.mystery.landing.b: %s day(s) ago a craft of the kind once seen only in the sky came down near %s, %s, and stayed the night. Grey figures were seen about it with lanterns of green fire. By morning it was gone, leaving a ring of burnt ground. The Editor no longer laughs at such reports.
gazette.hollowfrontier.mystery.mutilatio: %s day(s) ago a steer was found dead near %s, %s, cut with a surgeon's care, in a ring of scorched grass. No tracks led to it or away. Ranchers are keeping their herds close.
%s day(s) ago a great airship, cigar-shaped and strung with lights, crossed the sky near %s, %s, keeping no course any balloonist could name. The Editor would like a word with its owner.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.1.body: Three ranch hands swear they saw a silver plate fly over the mesa at midnight, humming like a beehive. The ranch has since run dry of whiskey.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.1.title: LIGHTS OVER THE BADLANDS
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.2.body: A grizzled miner claims that past the ice at the end of the world lies a second sun, burning inside the earth. He was last seen buying a great deal of warm socks.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.2.title: THE EARTH IS HOLLOW, SAYS OLD PROSPECTOR
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.3.body: An inventor drove a hissing brass contraption down Main Street on Tuesday. Two horses bolted and the inventor was fined for disturbing the peace.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.3.title: STEAM CARRIAGE FRIGHTENS HORSES
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.4.body: Glowing blue stones turned up in a prospector's pan. Assayers cannot name the mineral. One of them now hears humming at night.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.4.title: STRANGE CRYSTALS FOUND
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.5.body: A hotel guest found a rattlesnake coiled in her washbasin. Mind the sound of a rattle out in the desert, readers: back off slowly.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.5.title: RATTLER IN THE BATHTUB
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.6.body: A cigar-shaped craft crossed the county Thursday night, sweeping the ground with a bright light. Witnesses say it flew against the wind and made no sound at all. No airship company will own to it.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.6.title: AIRSHIP SIGHTED, NO BALLOON
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.7.body: A travelling professor will speak at the hall on the late Colonel Symmes' theory: that the world is open at both poles. He tells of an expedition of '89 that went in and did not come back. Admission ten cents.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.7.title: SYMMES' HOLE: A LECTURE
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.8.body: A whaling captain swears that past the pack ice the sea ran warm, and birds flew north toward land where no land should be. His crew would not sail on. He is buying a compass that points true north, if anyone has one.
gazette.hollowfrontier.odd.8.title: WHALER TELLS OF WARM SEAS
gazette.hollowfrontier.outlaws.body: A cattle drover reports a gang of desperadoes making camp near X %s, Z %s. Citizens are advised to keep clear, or to bring plenty of cartridges.
gazette.hollowfrontier.outlaws.title: OUTLAWS SPOTTED!
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.1.body: Nothing worth printing happened this week, which the editor considers a mercy.
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.1.title: A QUIET WEEK
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.2.body: The general store reports beans have risen to two coppers a can. The editor blames the railroad.
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.2.title: PRICE OF BEANS UP AGAIN
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.3.body: Pie was eaten. Hymns were sung. Nobody was shot.
gazette.hollowfrontier.quiet.3.title: CHURCH SOCIAL A SUCCESS
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.bank_lost: The bank reports %s gold and %s copper gone from its depositors' boxes.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.defended.bod: Townsfolk, lawmen and one stranger handy with a gun drove %1$s and the %2$s Gang out of %5$s near X %3$s, Z %4$s. Drinks are on the house.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.gave_up.body: The %2$s Gang shot up %5$s near X %3$s, Z %4$s until they tired of it. %1$s is still at large; see the town's Bounty Board.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.held.body: The lawmen of %5$s near X %3$s, Z %4$s turned back %1$s and the %2$s Gang without a stranger's help. The sheriff has been insufferable since.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.held.title: LAWMEN HOLD THE LINE
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.recovered.bo: The %2$s Gang cracked the vault in %5$s near X %3$s, Z %4$s, but their bagman never made it out of town. Every coin is back where it belongs.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.robbed.body: %1$s and the %2$s Gang cleaned out the vault of %5$s near X %3$s, Z %4$s and rode off into the night. A reward is posted at the town's Bounty Board.
gazette.hollowfrontier.raid.robbed.title: VAULT ROBBED!
gazette.hollowfrontier.saloon.body: Weary travellers will find a roadhouse saloon pouring near X %s, Z %s. The bartender is said to be friendly and the beer only a little warm.
gazette.hollowfrontier.saloon.title: WHISKEY ON THE TRAIL
gazette.hollowfrontier.wanted.body: %s, for robbing the Overland Stage. Reward: %s gold coins. Ask at any Bounty Board.
gazette.hollowfrontier.wanted.title: WANTED
gazette.hollowfrontier.wanted_you.body: One %s is sought by the law for crimes against decent folk. The sheriff will accept a fine of %s copper coins at any Bounty Board. Until then: shoot on sight.
gazette.hollowfrontier.wanted_you.title: WANTED: A DANGEROUS STRANGER
gui.hollowfrontier.blackjack.outcome.dea: The dealer busts. You're paid %s c.
gui.hollowfrontier.blackjack.rules: Dealer stands on 17. Blackjack pays 3:2. Limit %s c.
gui.hollowfrontier.blackjack.rules_sharp: Dealer hits soft 17. Blackjack pays 3:2. Limit %s c.
item.hollowfrontier.crystal_tablet.desc: Writing too fine for any pen, cut into crystal.
item.hollowfrontier.expedition_sextant.d: Engraved: Symmes Exp. No. 2. Useless where the sun never moves.
item.hollowfrontier.gray_specimen_jar.de: Something small in cloudy fluid. Best not to shake it.
item.hollowfrontier.ivory_carving.desc: A mammoth in mammoth tusk, carved by someone who'd seen one.
item.hollowfrontier.kindled_idol.desc: A figure in crystal, arms raised, lit from within.
item.hollowfrontier.map.foundry: Mining Co. Map: the Old Foundry
item.hollowfrontier.star_chart.desc: Stars where there is no sky to put them in.
item.hollowfrontier.starsteel_mask.desc: A calm face, too long and too narrow to be a man's.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.alien_alloy_plat: Salvage: break the wreckage at a crash site, on the frontier or under the crust. Eight of them, round a mended gravity drive, make a Prototype Saucer.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.beam_emitter: Salvage: found in some crash sites' wreckage, not all. Fit it to a Prototype Saucer for its tractor beam.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.boiler: Boils water into steam while it burns furnace fuel. Water comes in by bucket, by pipe, or from a water source block touching it (a well or a trough). Steam goes out to pipes, tanks and machines beside it.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.brass_star: Never made, only found: every frontier town's sheriff keeps a cat that wears the only one.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.cargo_hold: Given up by a Mothership called after the first (its rematches), every other time. Fit it to a Prototype Saucer for 9 slots of storage, opened from aboard with the hold key (H). What's in it stays with the saucer when it's folded.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.cloaking_device: Given up by a Mothership called after the first (its rematches), every other time. Fit it to a Prototype Saucer: at night, with a pilot aboard, nobody else can see the craft or its crew, and mobs lose track of them. The Grays' own craft can still see it.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.copper_pipe: Carries steam. Joins up with boilers, tanks, crushers and other pipes, and with other mods' tanks.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.damaged_gravity_: Salvage: found in some crash sites' wreckage, not all. Mend it with phlogiston and starsteel.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.gray_tech_fragme: Left by the Grays' work: tagged megafauna, mutilated cattle, Gray Wardens and drones, and the Gray labs under the crust.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.kindled_sigil: Given by the Kindled to an ally, and sold by them after. With Curios installed, it can be worn as a necklace.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.lens_array: Salvage: found in some crash sites' wreckage, not all. Fit it to a Prototype Saucer for its heat laser.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.letter_home: Handed over by a captive freed from a Gray pen in the Hollow Earth. Bring it to the Bounty Board or sheriff of the town it's addressed to for 3 gold, and your heat cleared.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.navigation_core: Salvage: found in some crash sites' wreckage, not all. Fit it to a Prototype Saucer for bearings home and to the nearest Polar Gateway.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.outlaw_badge: Carried by an Outlaw Boss. Take a Wanted Poster from a Bounty Board, bring the boss down, and turn the badge in at the board for gold coins.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.phlogiston_core: Left by the Sun Archon when it falls. The heart of the Phlogiston Beacon.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.pressure_gauge: Reads the highest steam pressure beside it. Use it to see the reading; a comparator gets 0 to 15 from it.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.steam_canister: Use it on a boiler, pipe or tank to fill it. Steam tools (the Steam Drill, the Polar Resonator) draw on canisters anywhere in your inventory.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.steam_tank: Holds steam for a network of pipes. Canisters fill from it, and an airship moored over one takes steam from it.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.strange_skull: Dug up from the strange grave on a town's Boot Hill.
jei.hollowfrontier.info.sunstone_shard: Left by the Sun Archon, and found in the Sun Temple.
message.hollowfrontier.abduction.missing: You come to on the ground, far from where you were. You can't account for the last few hours, and there's an itch behind your ear.
message.hollowfrontier.archon.corona: The Archon rises into the light, and the pylons blaze to shield it!
message.hollowfrontier.archon.corona_bar: The Archon rises into the light.
message.hollowfrontier.archon.eclipse: Eclipse! The Archon's light turns black.
message.hollowfrontier.archon.falls: The Archon falls, and the inner sun burns clean again.
message.hollowfrontier.archon.shield_bro: The last pylon breaks, and the Archon's shield fails!
message.hollowfrontier.archon.shielded: The pylons' light turns the blow aside.
message.hollowfrontier.archon.wakes: The Sun Archon lifts its head, and rises from its throne.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.fee: A box is one gold coin to open, partner. Free to use after that.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.interest: Your box earned %s copper in interest over %s day(s).
message.hollowfrontier.bank.no_bank: Bank? Out here? Find me a town with a vault and we'll talk.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.notice.lost: The %1$s Gang cracked the bank in %6$s near X %2$s, Z %3$s and got away with %4$s gold and %5$s copper from your box.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.notice.retur: The %1$s Gang cracked the bank in %6$s near X %2$s, Z %3$s and took %4$s gold and %5$s copper from your box, but the bagman never made it out. Every coin is back.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.opened: One gold coin, thank you kindly. That box is yours, and nobody else's.
message.hollowfrontier.bank.owed: The bank put back %s gold and %s copper it owed you.
message.hollowfrontier.banker.robbed: Cleaned us out, they did. Prices are up till the next payroll comes in.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.belle.1: Why, welcome, stranger. Do make yourself comfortable.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.belle.2: My, such fine manners. Something refined for you this evening?
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.belle.3: Mind the dust on those boots, darlin'. This is a respectable establishment.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.clementin: Howdy, sugar! Sarsaparilla's ice cold today!
Ooh, a new face! You stayin' in town long?
Coffee's strong enough to float a horseshoe. Want a cup, sweetie?
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.josie.1: You buyin', or just admirin' the scenery?
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.josie.2: I'd deal you in, darlin', but you look like you'd lose your boots.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.josie.3: Snake oil cures everything but a broken heart, honey. Want some?
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.lupe.1: ¡Hola, cariño! Mezcal, straight from my abuela's agave.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.lupe.2: Find the worm in your mezcal and you get a kiss... on the cheek.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.lupe.3: Coffee with cinnamon, the way my mamá made it. Sit, sit!
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.ruby.1: Well now, look what the wind blew in. What'll it be, darlin'?
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.ruby.2: Pull up a stool, stranger. The smile's free. The whiskey ain't.
message.hollowfrontier.barmaid.ruby.3: Easy on the moonshine, sugar. I'd hate for you to swoon before I do.
message.hollowfrontier.bath.fresh: You climb out of the tub feeling like new.
message.hollowfrontier.bath.sober: You climb out of the tub sober, pink and steaming.
message.hollowfrontier.bounty.already_ca: %s has already been brought in alive.
message.hollowfrontier.bounty.already_ha: You're already carrying a Wanted Poster.
message.hollowfrontier.bounty.none_up: Nothing's posted on this board right now.
message.hollowfrontier.bounty.raider: The sheriff hands you a fresh poster: %s, who rode on this town.
message.hollowfrontier.captive.escort: That's my face on your paper, ain't it. ...Fine. A cell in town beats a cold table.
message.hollowfrontier.captive.escort_hi: %s goes with you in irons. Walk him to the board or the sheriff of the town that posted him.
message.hollowfrontier.captive.letter: Here. I wrote it in the dark, on my knee. Get it home for me, would you?
message.hollowfrontier.captive.recognise: One of the faces behind these bars is on the poster you're carrying: %s. The Grays got to him first.
message.hollowfrontier.captive.strapped: I can't move! Stop the machine first, stop it!
message.hollowfrontier.captive.turned_in: The sheriff walks %s back to the cells. Brought in alive: %s gold, in full.
message.hollowfrontier.captive.wrong_tow: %s was posted in another town. Take him there.
message.hollowfrontier.carcass.look: The cuts are as neat as a surgeon's, and there isn't a drop of blood. The grass round it is scorched in a ring.
message.hollowfrontier.card_table.no_dea: Nobody's dealing. A barmaid has to be near to run the table.
message.hollowfrontier.disguised_gray.li: The town liked Mr. Gray. Folks look at you sideways now.
message.hollowfrontier.disguised_gray.to: Only one a day. I am told that is how a regular behaves.
message.hollowfrontier.disguised_gray.tr: A fair trade. Do not drink the shiny one. That is a joke. Do not drink it.
message.hollowfrontier.freed.hint: (Use him with %s gold coin in hand to swear him in as a deputy, or sneak and use him to send him home.)
message.hollowfrontier.freed.hired: I'll keep the peace here. Nobody's going to make me do otherwise again.
message.hollowfrontier.freed.home: Home, then. I've a claim out past the creek, if nobody's jumped it.
message.hollowfrontier.freed.no_town: Out here? There's nothing out here for a man. Find me a town and I'll make something of myself in it.
message.hollowfrontier.freed.offer: Whatever had hold of me is gone. I'd wear a star for this town, for a gold coin to start me off. Or I'd just go home and dig.
message.hollowfrontier.freed.wanted: Take a job from you? You're on the posters yourself, friend.
message.hollowfrontier.ghost_cat.no_dres: It slips right through the knot.
message.hollowfrontier.ghost_cat.no_musi: The ghost cat flickers, unmoved. Perhaps with a little music...
message.hollowfrontier.ghost_cat.raw: The ghost cat turns up its nose. It wants its fish cooked.
message.hollowfrontier.grumble.crop_circ: Wheat's been pressed flat in rings out past the edge of town. Every stalk laid the same way.
There's circles in the wheat again. Perfect ones. Who walks out at night with a compass and a roller?
I'd blame the kids for the rings in the wheat, if the kids could fly.
message.hollowfrontier.grumble.mutilatio: Lost another steer last night. Cut up neat as you please, and no wolf did that.
Found one of the herd dead in a burned ring. Not a drop of blood. The others won't go near the spot.
Somebody's cutting up cattle out there, and it ain't rustlers. Rustlers take the meat.
You see that airship go over the other night? Lights all down its length, and quiet as a cloud.
Half the town was out watching the sky last night. A great cigar of lights, they say, going east.
The preacher says those lights are a sign. The sheriff says they're a drunk. I don't know what I saw.
message.hollowfrontier.guardian.gray: The guardian's eye turns to the Gray things you carry.
message.hollowfrontier.guardian.warning: The beam scorches the stone at your feet: a warning.
message.hollowfrontier.guardian.wronged: The guardian knows what you did.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.allied: The Kindled have taken you for an ally.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.friend: The Kindled count you a friend.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.greet.0: Walk softly here. The stones remember.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.greet.1: The guardians know you. They will not trouble you while you keep faith.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.greet.2: Bring us what the grey ones leave behind. Better in our hands than theirs.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.greet.3: There were thousands of us once. Now there are the few you see.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.0: We were here before your people had a word for the north. This land was Concavia, and the sun inside it was ours to keep.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.1: The small grey ones came down out of the dark between the stars, hungry and polite. We let them in. That was our first mistake, and our last.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.2: They took our cities, our craft and our phlogiston. The ships your people see over the plains were never theirs. They were ours.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.3: Your outlaws are not born cruel. The grey ones take drifters off the plains, set a seed of metal behind the ear, and send them back angry.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.4: The men in the black coats are the same work, done more carefully. They chose the leash, for money and long life. Pity them, but don't trust them.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.5: A frontier at war with itself never looks up. That is all the grey ones want of the world above.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.6: Carry our sigil. In its light the seed behind the ear shows, through stone and through dark. You will know them by it.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.7: When the grey ones came, our last king went into the heart of the inner sun to hold it against them. He did not come out as he went in.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.line.8: If you go to the sun's temple, go armed. What sits on that throne answers to no one now. We call it the Archon.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.refuse: You have hurt our people. We have nothing to say to you.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.sigil: You are given a Kindled Sigil.
message.hollowfrontier.kindled.temple: The sun's temple stands in the Ember Badlands, near %s, %s.
message.hollowfrontier.landing.cleared: With its keepers down, the saucer lifts off in a hurry and leaves its cache behind.
message.hollowfrontier.landing.dawn: With the dawn the saucer takes its keepers and its cargo aboard, and lifts off.
message.hollowfrontier.landing.sealed: Sealed. Its keepers are still about.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.deputy.1: Sheriff says I'm to keep an eye on strangers. So... howdy.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.deputy.2: Two barrels of buckshot says this town stays quiet.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.marshal.1: Federal business. Seen any riders with a red bandana?
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.marshal.2: Law runs as far as my rifle reaches. That's a fair piece.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.ranger.1: One riot, one ranger. Mind your manners.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.ranger.2: Trail's been hot with outlaws. Ride careful out there.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.sheriff.1: Keep your iron holstered in my town, and we'll get along fine.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.sheriff.2: Bounties are on the board. Bring 'em in breathin' if you can.
message.hollowfrontier.lawman.warning: I've got my eye on you, stranger. Step out of line again and you'll hang.
message.hollowfrontier.leash_broken.1: Across the frontier, men stop where they stand and put a hand behind one ear. Whatever whispered there is quiet.
message.hollowfrontier.leash_broken.2: The men in black dusters walk off into the dust and don't come back. No one is watching the sky for the Grays any more.
message.hollowfrontier.leash_broken.3: The outlaws who still ride now ride by their own choice. What the frontier makes of itself is its own again.
message.hollowfrontier.letter_home.deliv: Word from someone the town had given up on. They pay you %s gold for it, and somebody cries.
message.hollowfrontier.letter_home.no_to: This letter is for a town's board or sheriff.
message.hollowfrontier.letter_home.pardo: The sheriff decides he never saw your face on that board.
message.hollowfrontier.letter_home.wrong: Wrong town. This one is for the town near %s, %s.
message.hollowfrontier.man_in_black.boug: Obliged. Best forget where you found it.
That belongs to some friends of ours. They'll be glad of it.
A fair price for something you never had.
message.hollowfrontier.man_in_black.free: ...I was promised a long life. Funny. I think I'd rather have my own.
message.hollowfrontier.man_in_black.gree: Fine evening. You haven't seen anything strange in the sky, have you? No. Of course not.
We're with the government. Of a sort.
Weather balloon. That's all it ever is. A weather balloon.
message.hollowfrontier.man_in_black.warn: You've been asking about things that don't concern you. Stop.
There's a lot of empty country out there. Folks get lost in it. Folks who go looking.
Whatever you think you saw, you didn't. We'd like you to remember that.
message.hollowfrontier.missing_time.bed: You come to in somebody's bed. It's an hour later than it was, and the hat on your head isn't yours.
message.hollowfrontier.missing_time.hay: You come to face down in a hay bale. An hour's gone somewhere, and so has your hat. Somebody left you theirs.
message.hollowfrontier.missing_time.trou: You come to sitting in a horse trough. You've lost an hour, and somebody's put a hat on you.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.abduct: The Mothership raises its shield and sends out its drones. Its beam is warming.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.arrive: The Mothership hangs over the beacon. Its drones are waking.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.coming: The stars over the beacon go out, one by one. It's coming down.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.expose: The Mothership comes down low, its belly opening on a burning core. Its shield is up again.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.falls: The Mothership falls burning out of the sky.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.leaves: With no one left to fight, the Mothership rises into the dark and is gone.
message.hollowfrontier.mothership.return: The Mothership is back over the beacon, and it's brought more drones than last time.
message.hollowfrontier.no_charge: No charge left in your Phlogiston Cells
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.freed.1: ...where am I? What have I been doing?
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.freed.2: It's quiet. It's never been quiet before.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.freed.3: I don't want this gun. I never did.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.1: Hey! Fetch me them keys and I'll cut you in on the loot.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.2: My gang'll bust me outta here by sundown. You'll see.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.3: Beans again? A man could starve in this jail.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.4: Whatcha lookin' at? Ain't you never seen a desperado?
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.5: I was framed, I tell ya! Framed!
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.6: That cat's been starin' at me all day. Somebody make it quit.
message.hollowfrontier.outlaw.jeer.7: Sheriff's cat is the only deputy in this town worth a lick. Hissed me right into this cell.
message.hollowfrontier.pens.cleared: The last of the pen's keepers is down. Nobody's coming back for this place.
message.hollowfrontier.phlogiston_beacon: The beacon's light goes up into the night. Something up there answers.
The beacon is silent. It needs the open sky above it.
The beacon is silent. Whatever it calls is only in the skies of the Overworld.
The beacon is silent. It is heard only at night.
message.hollowfrontier.piano.playing: The piano strikes up a rag.
message.hollowfrontier.polar_compass.bea: The needle settles: a gateway lies some %s blocks %s
message.hollowfrontier.polar_compass.los: The needle wanders. No gateway within reach
message.hollowfrontier.polar_resonator.b: Something's lying in the well. Clear it first
The ring is broken. It won't ring true
message.hollowfrontier.polar_resonator.n: Not enough steam: the resonator needs %s mB from your canisters
message.hollowfrontier.procedure.finishe: The straps fall open. %s sits up, and their eyes are wrong.
message.hollowfrontier.procedure.started: Something hums to life over the operating table. The Grays have started on %s.
message.hollowfrontier.procedure.stopped: The rig whines down and goes dark. The one on the table is still themselves.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.leader.arriv: This here's a robbery! Nobody plays the hero, nobody gets hurt!
message.hollowfrontier.raid.leader.crack: She's open! Grab the loot and ride!
message.hollowfrontier.raid.leader.cut: Here's your cut, partner. Don't spend it all in one saloon.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.leader.give_: Dawn's coming. We're done here, boys!
message.hollowfrontier.raid.over.defende: The dust settles. %s won't be back in a hurry.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.over.held: The town's lawmen saw off %s on their own.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.over.recover: %s rode off with nothing but lead: the loot is back in the vault.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.pardon: The sheriff tears up a few of your warrants.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.partner: The bell's ringing for outlaws, and you're one of them. Keep out of the gang's way and there may be a cut in it for you.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.poster: A Wanted Poster for %s is going up on the town's Bounty Board.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.reward: Much obliged, partner. Here's %s gold and %s copper for your trouble.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.ride_in: Here they come: %s, riding in from %s!
message.hollowfrontier.raid.safecracker_: The safecracker's down! The vault holds.
message.hollowfrontier.raid.truce: The law has bigger problems tonight. Help defend the town and your name may come clean.
message.hollowfrontier.restoration.done: The ruin stands whole again. There's nothing left to mend.
message.hollowfrontier.restoration.not_a: The fountain is still. The Kindled won't build again while the Grays hold their leash on the frontier.
The fountain is still. Only an ally of the Kindled can wake it.
message.hollowfrontier.restoration.short: Stage %3$s needs %1$s phlogiston shards and %2$s starsteel ingots.
message.hollowfrontier.restoration.stage: The fountain drinks the phlogiston and the starsteel. With a sound like ice settling, a fallen tower climbs back out of its rubble.
Light runs along the sanctum's windows, and a second tower stands whole. The Kindled stop what they're doing to watch.
The last tower rises, the paving closes over, and on its dais at the plaza's edge the old waystone wakes.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.fold_aloft: Land it before folding it up.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.fold_crewe: Everyone has to get out before it folds up.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.hold_outsi: Climb aboard to open the hold.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.no_hold: This saucer has no cargo hold.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.no_phlogis: No phlogiston: carry a Phlogiston Cell or a phlogiston shard, or use one on the saucer
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.no_room: There's no room to set the saucer down here.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.overheated: The heat laser has overheated: let it cool.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.refuelled: The saucer draws phlogiston from what you carry.
message.hollowfrontier.saucer.struggled_: You struggle free of the beam.
message.hollowfrontier.sheriff_cat.loyal: The sheriff's cat only has eyes for the Sheriff.
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.0: Guaranteed to cure baldness, or your money back!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.1: Also removes rust from tools, and grudges from in-laws!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.2: Settles the nerves! Slows the blood to a gentle trot!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.3: Shrinks the liver to a manageable size!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.4: Proven against snakebite, gout and bad cards!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.5: Tastes of nothing but good health!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.6: Puts a spring in your step!
message.hollowfrontier.snake_oil.7: Keeps both feet firmly on the ground! Endorsed by gentlemen from very far away.
message.hollowfrontier.strange_skull.cal: A hum, far up. Something is coming.
message.hollowfrontier.strange_skull.not: Nothing answers. Try under the open sky, at night.
message.hollowfrontier.suspicion.eased: The feeling of being watched passes.
message.hollowfrontier.suspicion.hunted: Two dark figures are coming across the dark toward you.
message.hollowfrontier.townsfolk.refuse: We don't serve your kind here. Git!
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.1: The law has its eye on you.
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.2: You're WANTED! Lawmen will shoot on sight.
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.3: Dead or alive! There's a price on your head.
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.fine: Your fine is %s copper coins (gold coins count as 9).
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.paid: Paid a %s copper coin fine. Your name is clear.
message.hollowfrontier.wanted.posse: A posse is riding out after you!
message.hollowfrontier.waystone.alone: The waystone hums, but there's nowhere yet for it to send you.
message.hollowfrontier.waystone.fare: The waystone wants %s phlogiston shard to carry you.
subtitles.hollowfrontier.raid.lost: Gang rides off with the loot
title.hollowfrontier.raid.recovered.sub: The bagman is down. The money goes back in the vault.
title.hollowfrontier.raid.robbed.sub: Stop the bagman before he rides out!
tooltip.hollowfrontier.airship.controls: Jump to climb, sprint to descend, sneak to step off
tooltip.hollowfrontier.airship.fuel: Burns coal or charcoal; takes steam from canisters or a steam tank under its keel
tooltip.hollowfrontier.alien_alloy_plati: Hull plating off a Gray saucer. Lighter than tin, harder than steel.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.bandana: Tie it round your cat's neck (dyeable)
tooltip.hollowfrontier.beam_emitter: The eye of a saucer's lifting beam.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.bounty.badge_hint: Turn in at a Bounty Board.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.bounty.captive: Held by the Grays, deep below
tooltip.hollowfrontier.bounty.poster_hin: Ride out to the hideout. Bring back the badge.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.brass_star: Your cat hisses at outlaws and wanted folk, and shows them up
tooltip.hollowfrontier.cargo_hold: A Gray hold, roomier inside than out. Fits under a saucer's deck.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.cat_accessory: Use on your cat; sneak-use with an empty hand to take it back
tooltip.hollowfrontier.cloaking_device: Bends the light round a saucer. It hums at night, and does nothing at all by day.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.damaged_gravity_d: What held a saucer up, cracked in the crash. Phlogiston and starsteel might mend it.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.glyptodon_shell: Full set: sneak to shell up (projectiles do a quarter, explosions half)
tooltip.hollowfrontier.gravity_drive: What holds a saucer up, mended. It wants to rise.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.hide_barding: Horse armor. Steadies a horse against knockback
tooltip.hollowfrontier.horse_gear_hint: Use on a tamed horse. Sneak + shears removes gear.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.kindled_sigil: Hold it, and the seed behind the ear shows.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.lens_array: Rows of tiny lenses that once focused something hot.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.letter_home.hint: Bring it to that town's Bounty Board or sheriff
tooltip.hollowfrontier.navigation_core: A saucer's sense of where it is. It still turns toward the poles.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.oliphant: Calms angry beasts and scatters terror birds nearby
tooltip.hollowfrontier.paxel: Pickaxe, axe and shovel in one
tooltip.hollowfrontier.phlogiston_core: The burning heart the last king carried. It is what the Grays came for.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.phlogiston_gun: Draws %s charge a shot from the Phlogiston Cells you carry
tooltip.hollowfrontier.phlogiston_gun.pi: The beam goes through up to %s creatures
tooltip.hollowfrontier.polar_compass.set: Bearing taken. Use again to take a fresh one
tooltip.hollowfrontier.polar_compass.uns: Use to take a bearing on the nearest Polar Gateway
tooltip.hollowfrontier.polar_resonator: Use on a Polar Gateway's ring to open it (%s mB of steam from canisters). Sneak-use to shut it
No fittings yet: use a beam emitter, lens array, navigation core, cloaking device or cargo hold on the saucer

Set it down on the ground and climb in. W/S/A/D fly, jump climbs, sprint descends; V heat laser, B tractor beam, H cargo hold. Land, get out and sneak-use it bare-handed to fold it up. Only you and your team can fit it or fold it.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.relic: A town prospector pays %s gold coins
tooltip.hollowfrontier.reload_hint: Reload key or sneak + use loads one chamber at a time
tooltip.hollowfrontier.signal_locator.se: Tuned to a Gray signal. Use to take a new bearing.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.signal_locator.un: Use to listen for the nearest Gray station
tooltip.hollowfrontier.snakeskin_boots.3: Faster on sand; counts as Cowboy Boots
tooltip.hollowfrontier.starsteel_horsesh: A horse shod in starsteel, and its rider, take no fall damage
tooltip.hollowfrontier.steam_drill: Uses %s mB of steam per block from Steam Canisters in your inventory
tooltip.hollowfrontier.strange_skull: Dug up on Boot Hill. Hold it up to the night sky.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.sunstone_lens: Hold it to see in the dark. Use it to throw a beam of sunlight.
tooltip.hollowfrontier.talon_knife: Skinning: what you kill drops one more hide, tusk, talon, scute or snakeskin
